subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which public WhatsApp sticker-send contract should OpenClaw support: shared `action=sticker`, a WhatsApp send option such as `asSticker`, automatic WebP detection, or a combined explicit-plus-detection path?
rationale: Source proves the send gap, but silent WebP detection and sticker re-encoding policy can change ordinary image sends and need maintainer product intent.

options.title: Explicit sticker intent
options.body: Expose `action=sticker` or a WhatsApp-specific send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

options.title: Automatic WebP detection
options.body: Treat qualifying WebP media as stickers by heuristic, accepting possible misclassification of ordinary WebP images or malformed assets.

options.title: Defer channel feature
options.body: Keep inbound sticker support only until a broader cross-channel sticker contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Explicit sticker intent
recommendation.body: Expose `action=sticker` or a WhatsApp-specific send option and route media as stickers only when that intent is present.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest recent history on the lower-level structured WhatsApp send support and adjacent QA/runtime proof surface.
